title: Fixed Curved Plate and Twin Ball Hand Rattle
description: One newly authored whole hand-held curved-plate percussion exterior in a fixed upright display pose. A short turned wooden grip with a finite flat butt carries a complete open round-section U frame. A single broad, genuinely thick curved metal leaf is clamped at its upper end and hangs freely within that frame. Two separate continuous thin curved arms rise from a common lower mounting block to complete wooden ball tips on opposite sides of the leaf; a visible small air interval remains at the illustrated tips. Unlike the old cabasa there is no drum core or surrounding beaded loops, and unlike the old U-return ball and tine-box rattle this is not one rod joining two end masses: the full enclosing frame carries a central open-sided leaf and two independent flanking ball arms. No old handle, rod, ball or plate mesh extracted. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum; one whole prop zero scenes.
